question: If (k-kcot²30^circ)/(1+cot² 30circ⁾= sin² 60° + 4 tan²45° - cosec²60°, then the value of k (correct to two decimal places) is :
solution:
Given: 

 (k-kcot²30^circ)/(1+cot² 30circ⁾= sin2 60° + 4 tan245° - cosec260°

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fc2a77f638a89accf21851b8261342f31a55f78c75cfccb097a2b4c3334d9d4.png] 

Calculation:

 (k-kcot²30^circ)/(1+cot² 30circ⁾= sin2 60° + 4 tan245° - cosec260°

⇒ k frac {1 - 3}{1 + 3} = 3/4 + 4 × 1 - 4/3

⇒ frac {-k}{2} = 41/12

⇒ k = -41/6

⇒ k ≈ -6.83

**∴ The value of k is -6.83.**
